parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The tag type. Valid values:
- **System**: tags created by the system.
- **Custom**: tags added by users.

> If this parameter is left empty, publicly visible tags are returned by default.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. This parameter is used together with PageSize. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of tag keys to return on each page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE**.
